fullPassage:
The early grain trade firms were active in both surplus-producing and food deficit regions, and these firms made it their business to know the state of supply and demand in both. Because this information was the key to their ____________________, these firms worked in relative secrecy, frequently built on family ties, trust, and loyalty. In addition, these firms were able to benefit from the rise of commodity exchanges and commodities futures markets that emerged in the mid-1800s. Agricultural markets are naturally unstable, due to changes in harvest size that result from variable weather patterns and other factors. Locking-in prices by buying and selling grain for future delivery helped these firms to minimize such risks. It made sense for the grain trading companies to manage their risks within a single firm that was operating in more than one country, rather than operating as independent national companies trading with each other. Their access to information in multiple markets enabled them to easily cover the risks associated with agricultural commodity trade.

* deficit: 부족

questions.passage: The early grain trade firms were active in both surplus-producing and food deficit regions, and these firms made it their business to know the state of (A)[supply / demand] and demand in both. Because this information was the key to their profitability, these firms worked in relative (B)[secrecy / publicity], frequently built on family ties, trust, and (C)[loyalty / betrayal].
questions.stem: 다음 글의 (A), (B), (C)에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것끼리 짝지은 것은?

det.korean: 초기 곡물 무역 회사들은 공급(supply)과 수요의 상태를 파악하는 것을 사업으로 삼았습니다. 이 정보가 수익성의 핵심이었기에 상대적으로 비밀리에(secrecy) 운영되었고, 가족 유대, 신뢰, 충성심(loyalty)에 기반하여 활동했습니다.
det.analysis:
✅ ① supply — secrecy — loyalty: 원문과 정확히 일치
❌ ② demand는 supply 위치에 부적절 (supply and demand에서 앞은 supply)
❌ ③ publicity(공개)는 secrecy(비밀)의 반의어
❌ ④ betrayal(배신)은 loyalty(충성)의 반의어
det.tip: supply and demand(수요와 공급), secrecy(비밀), loyalty(충성심) — 곡물 무역의 핵심 어휘 세트

questions.passage: Agricultural markets are naturally (A)[unstable / stable], due to changes in harvest size that result from (B)[variable / constant] weather patterns and other factors. Locking-in prices by buying and selling grain for future delivery helped these firms to (C)[minimize / maximize] such risks.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 (A), (B), (C)에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것끼리 짝지은 것은?

det.korean: 농업 시장은 본질적으로 불안정(unstable)하며, 변동하는(variable) 날씨 패턴 등에 의한 수확량 변화 때문입니다. 가격을 고정하는 것이 이러한 위험을 최소화(minimize)하는 데 도움이 되었습니다.
det.analysis:
✅ ① unstable — variable — minimize: 원문과 정확히 일치
❌ ② stable(안정적인)은 unstable의 반의어
❌ ③ constant(일정한)는 variable(변동하는)의 반의어
❌ ④ maximize(극대화)는 minimize(최소화)의 반의어
det.tip: unstable(불안정한) ↔ stable, variable(변동하는) ↔ constant, minimize(최소화) ↔ maximize

questions.passage: It made sense for the grain trading companies to manage their risks within a (A)[single / multiple] firm that was operating in more than one country, rather than operating as (B)[independent / cooperative] national companies trading with each other. Their access to information in (C)[multiple / limited] markets enabled them to easily cover the risks.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 (A), (B), (C)에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것끼리 짝지은 것은?

det.korean: 곡물 무역 회사들이 여러 나라에서 운영되는 하나의(single) 회사 내에서 위험을 관리하는 것이 독립적인(independent) 국가별 회사들이 서로 거래하는 것보다 합리적이었습니다. 여러(multiple) 시장의 정보 접근이 위험을 쉽게 상쇄할 수 있게 했습니다.
det.analysis:
✅ ③ single — independent — multiple: 원문과 정확히 일치
❌ ① multiple은 single 위치에 부적절 (a single firm이 원문)
❌ ② cooperative(협력적인)는 independent(독립적인)와 반대 의미
❌ ④ limited(제한된)는 multiple(다수의)과 반대 의미
det.tip: single firm vs. independent national companies — 다국적 단일 기업 vs. 독립 국가 기업의 대조 구조 파악이 핵심

questions.passage: The early grain trade firms were active in both surplus-producing and food deficit regions, and these firms made it their business to know the state of supply and demand in both. Because this information was the key to their profitability, these firms worked in relative secrecy, frequently built on family ties, trust, and loyalty. In addition, these firms were able to benefit from the rise of commodity exchanges and commodities futures markets that ①<u>emerged</u> in the mid-1800s. Agricultural markets are naturally ②<u>unstable</u>, due to changes in harvest size that result from ③<u>variable</u> weather patterns and other factors. Locking-in prices by buying and selling grain for future delivery helped these firms to ④<u>maximize</u> such risks.
questions.stem: 밑줄 친 단어 중, 문맥상 낱말의 쓰임이 적절하지 않은 것은?

det.korean: ①emerged(등장했다), ②unstable(불안정한), ③variable(변동하는)은 원문과 일치합니다. ④maximize(극대화하다)는 원문의 minimize(최소화하다)를 반의어로 교체한 것입니다.
det.analysis:
✅ ①②③: 원문 그대로
❌ ④ maximize(극대화하다) → 원문은 minimize(최소화하다). 위험을 '극대화'하는 것은 문맥상 부적절
det.tip: minimize(최소화) ↔ maximize(극대화): 위험 관리 맥락에서 minimize가 적절

questions.passage: The early grain trade firms were ①<u>active</u> in both surplus-producing and food deficit regions. Because this information was the key to their profitability, these firms worked in relative ②<u>openness</u>, frequently built on family ties, trust, and loyalty. It made sense for the grain trading companies to manage their risks within a single firm that was ③<u>operating</u> in more than one country. Their access to information in multiple markets enabled them to easily ④<u>cover</u> the risks associated with agricultural commodity trade.
questions.stem: 밑줄 친 단어 중, 문맥상 낱말의 쓰임이 적절하지 않은 것은?

det.korean: ①active(활동적인), ③operating(운영하는), ④cover(상쇄하다)는 원문과 일치합니다. ②openness(공개성)는 원문의 secrecy(비밀)를 반의어로 교체한 것입니다.
det.analysis:
✅ ①③④: 원문 그대로
❌ ② openness(공개성) → 원문은 secrecy(비밀). 수익성의 핵심인 정보를 '공개적으로' 운영했다는 것은 문맥상 부적절
det.tip: secrecy(비밀) ↔ openness(공개): 정보 우위를 위해 비밀리에 운영한 것이 핵심

questions.passage: The early grain trade firms were active in both surplus-producing and food deficit regions, and these firms made it their business to know the state of supply and demand in both. Because this information was the key to their profitability, these firms worked in relative secrecy, frequently built on family ties, trust, and loyalty. It made sense for the grain trading companies to manage their risks within a ①<u>single</u> firm that was operating in more than one country, rather than operating as ②<u>independent</u> national companies trading with each other. Their access to information in ③<u>limited</u> markets enabled them to easily ④<u>cover</u> the risks associated with agricultural commodity trade.
questions.stem: 밑줄 친 단어 중, 문맥상 낱말의 쓰임이 적절하지 않은 것은?

det.korean: ①single(단일의), ②independent(독립적인), ④cover(상쇄하다)는 원문과 일치합니다. ③limited(제한된)는 원문의 multiple(다수의)를 반의어로 교체한 것입니다.
det.analysis:
✅ ①②④: 원문 그대로
❌ ③ limited(제한된) → 원문은 multiple(다수의). 다수의 시장에 대한 접근이 위험을 상쇄할 수 있게 한 것이므로 '제한된'은 문맥상 부적절
det.tip: multiple(다수의) ↔ limited(제한된): 다국적 무역에서 여러 시장 접근이 핵심이라는 맥락 파악 필요

questions.passage: The early grain trade firms were active in both surplus-producing and food deficit regions, and these firms made it their business to know the state of supply and demand in both. Because this information was the key to their profitability, these firms worked in relative secrecy, frequently built on family ties, trust, and loyalty. In addition, these firms were able to benefit from the rise of __________ exchanges and futures markets that emerged in the mid-1800s. Agricultural markets are naturally unstable, due to changes in harvest size that result from variable weather patterns and other factors. Locking-in prices by buying and selling grain for future delivery helped these firms to minimize such risks.
questions.stem: 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: 이 회사들은 1800년대 중반에 등장한 상품(commodity) 거래소와 선물 시장의 부상으로부터 혜택을 얻을 수 있었습니다.
det.analysis:
✅ ② commodity(상품): commodity exchanges(상품 거래소)는 원문 표현 그대로
❌ ① currency(통화): 통화 거래소는 곡물 무역과 무관
❌ ③ property(재산): 부동산 거래소는 맥락과 불일치
❌ ④ security(증권): 증권 거래소는 곡물과 직접 관련 없음
det.tip: commodity exchange = 상품 거래소. commodity는 '원자재, 1차 상품'을 의미

questions.passage: The early grain trade firms were active in both surplus-producing and food deficit regions, and these firms made it their business to know the state of supply and demand in both. Because this information was the key to their profitability, these firms worked in relative secrecy, frequently built on family ties, trust, and loyalty. In addition, these firms were able to benefit from the rise of commodity exchanges and commodities futures markets that emerged in the mid-1800s. Agricultural markets are naturally unstable, due to changes in __________ size that result from variable weather patterns and other factors. Locking-in prices by buying and selling grain for future delivery helped these firms to minimize such risks.
questions.stem: 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: 농업 시장은 변동하는 날씨 패턴 등에 의한 수확량(harvest) 변화 때문에 본질적으로 불안정합니다.
det.analysis:
✅ ③ harvest(수확): harvest size(수확량)는 원문 표현 그대로
❌ ① market(시장): market size는 문맥상 날씨와 직접 연관 없음
❌ ② profit(이윤): profit size는 부자연스러운 연어
❌ ④ export(수출): export size는 날씨 패턴의 직접적 결과가 아님
det.tip: harvest size = 수확량. 날씨(weather patterns)와 직접 연결되는 것은 수확(harvest)

questions.passage: The early grain trade firms were active in both surplus-producing and food deficit regions, and these firms made it their business to know the state of supply and demand in both. Because this information was the key to their __________, these firms worked in relative secrecy, frequently built on family ties, trust, and loyalty. In addition, these firms were able to benefit from the rise of commodity exchanges and commodities futures markets that emerged in the mid-1800s. It made sense for the grain trading companies to manage their risks within a single firm that was operating in more than one country, rather than operating as independent national companies trading with each other. Their access to information in multiple markets enabled them to easily cover the risks associated with agricultural commodity trade.
questions.stem: 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: 이 정보가 수익성(profitability)의 핵심이었기 때문에, 이들 회사는 상대적으로 비밀리에 운영되었습니다.
det.analysis:
✅ ④ profitability(수익성): 공급·수요 정보가 곧 수익의 열쇠라는 인과관계
❌ ① transparency(투명성): secrecy(비밀)와 모순
❌ ② reputation(평판): 비밀리에 운영하는 이유로 부적절
❌ ③ sustainability(지속가능성): 정보와 지속가능성의 직접적 인과 약함
det.tip: 정보(information) → 수익성(profitability) → 비밀 운영(secrecy)의 인과관계 파악이 핵심

questions.passage: Agricultural markets are naturally unstable, due to changes in harvest size that result from variable weather patterns and other factors. Locking-in prices by buying and selling grain for future delivery helped these firms to <u>minimize</u> such risks.
questions.stem: 밑줄 친 minimize와 의미가 가장 가까운 것은?

det.korean: minimize는 '최소화하다'라는 뜻으로, reduce(줄이다)와 동의어입니다.
det.analysis:
✅ ① reduce(줄이다) ≈ minimize(최소화하다)
❌ ② increase(증가시키다): 반의어
❌ ③ transfer(이전하다): 위험 이전은 다른 개념
❌ ④ identify(확인하다): 위험 식별은 최소화와 다름
det.tip: minimize = reduce = lessen = diminish: '줄이다' 동의어군

questions.passage: The early grain trade firms were active in both surplus-producing and food deficit regions, and these firms made it their business to know the state of supply and demand in both. Because this information was the key to their profitability, these firms worked in relative secrecy, frequently built on family ties, trust, and loyalty. In addition, these firms were able to <u>benefit</u> from the rise of commodity exchanges and commodities futures markets that emerged in the mid-1800s.
questions.stem: 밑줄 친 benefit과 의미가 가장 가까운 것은?

det.korean: benefit from은 '~로부터 혜택을 얻다'라는 뜻으로, profit(이익을 얻다)와 동의어입니다.
det.analysis:
✅ ③ profit(이익을 얻다) ≈ benefit(혜택을 얻다)
❌ ① suffer(고통받다): 반의어
❌ ② withdraw(철수하다): 관련 없음
❌ ④ contribute(기여하다): 방향이 반대 (주는 것 vs 받는 것)
det.tip: benefit from = profit from = gain from: '~로부터 이익을 얻다'

questions.passage: The early grain trade firms were active in both surplus-producing and food deficit regions, and these firms made it their business to know the state of supply and demand in both. In addition, these firms were able to benefit from the rise of commodity exchanges and commodities futures markets that <u>emerged</u> in the mid-1800s. Agricultural markets are naturally unstable, due to changes in harvest size that result from variable weather patterns.
questions.stem: 밑줄 친 emerged와 의미가 가장 가까운 것은?

det.korean: emerged는 '등장했다, 나타났다'라는 뜻으로, arose(발생했다)와 동의어입니다.
det.analysis:
✅ ② arose(발생했다) ≈ emerged(등장했다)
❌ ① disappeared(사라졌다): 반의어
❌ ③ collapsed(붕괴했다): 부정적 의미
❌ ④ declined(쇠퇴했다): emerged의 반대 방향
det.tip: emerge = arise = appear = come into being: '등장하다' 동의어군. disappeared, declined은 반의어

questions.passage: The early grain trade firms were active in both <u>surplus</u>-producing and food deficit regions, and these firms made it their business to know the state of supply and demand in both. Because this information was the key to their profitability, these firms worked in relative secrecy.
questions.stem: 밑줄 친 surplus와 의미가 가장 반대인 것은?

det.korean: surplus는 '잉여, 과잉'이라는 뜻으로, shortage(부족)가 반의어입니다.
det.analysis:
✅ ④ shortage(부족) ↔ surplus(잉여)
❌ ① excess(과잉): surplus의 동의어
❌ ② abundance(풍부함): surplus의 유사어
❌ ③ supply(공급): 관련 있지만 반의어 아님
det.tip: surplus(잉여) ↔ deficit/shortage(부족): 본문에서도 surplus ↔ deficit 대조 구조

questions.passage: Because this information was the key to their profitability, these firms worked in <u>relative</u> secrecy, frequently built on family ties, trust, and loyalty. Agricultural markets are naturally unstable, due to changes in harvest size that result from variable weather patterns and other factors.
questions.stem: 밑줄 친 relative와 의미가 가장 반대인 것은?

det.korean: relative는 여기서 '상대적인'이라는 뜻으로, absolute(절대적인)가 반의어입니다.
det.analysis:
✅ ① absolute(절대적인) ↔ relative(상대적인)
❌ ② partial(부분적인): 관련은 있으나 정확한 반의어 아님
❌ ③ moderate(적당한): 유사한 뉘앙스
❌ ④ comparative(비교의): relative의 동의어
det.tip: relative(상대적인) ↔ absolute(절대적인): relative secrecy = '상대적인 비밀' (완전한 비밀은 아닌)

questions.passage:
(A) Their access to information in multiple markets enabled them to easily <u>cover</u> the risks associated with agricultural commodity trade.

(B) The newspaper was the first to <u>cover</u> the story of the grain trade scandal in 1850.
questions.stem: 밑줄 친 cover가 (A)와 (B)에서 각각 의미하는 바로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: (A)에서 cover the risks는 위험을 상쇄하다, (B)에서 cover the story는 기사를 보도하다라는 뜻입니다.
det.analysis:
✅ ② (A) 상쇄하다 — (B) 보도하다: 각 문맥에 정확히 부합
❌ ① (A)(B) 의미가 뒤바뀜
❌ ③ 포함하다/덮다는 두 문맥 모두 부적절
❌ ④ 덮다/포함하다 역시 문맥 불일치
det.tip: cover는 대표적 다의어: 덮다/상쇄하다/보도하다/포함하다/이동하다 등. 문맥별 의미 구분 중요

questions.stem:
다음 영영풀이에 해당하는 단어는?

"the state of being kept secret or private"

det.korean: '비밀로 유지되는 상태'는 secrecy(비밀)의 정의입니다.
det.analysis:
✅ ③ secrecy(비밀): 영영풀이와 정확히 일치
❌ ① loyalty(충성심): 충실함의 상태
❌ ② publicity(공개, 홍보): secrecy의 반의어
❌ ④ security(보안): 비슷하지만 '안전 보장'의 의미
det.tip: secrecy = the state of being kept secret. security(보안)와 혼동 주의 — secrecy는 '감추는 것', security는 '지키는 것'

questions.passage: Agricultural markets are naturally unstable, due to changes in harvest size that result from variable weather patterns. The __________ (stable) of prices was never guaranteed in the grain trade. Locking-in prices helped firms minimize such risks.
questions.stem: 괄호 안의 단어를 알맞은 형태로 바꿔 쓰시오.

det.korean: stable(형용사: 안정적인) → stability(명사: 안정성). 관사 The 뒤에 명사가 필요합니다.
det.analysis:
The + __________ + of prices 구조에서 관사 뒤 명사 필요 → stability
stable(형) → stability(명) / stabilize(동) / stably(부)
det.tip: stable → stability (명사화): -ity 접미사는 형용사를 명사로 변환. possible → possibility, able → ability

questions.passage: Because this information was the key to their profitability, these firms worked in relative secrecy. These firms __________ (frequent) built their networks on family ties and trust, keeping their operations secret. Their access to information in multiple markets was crucial.
questions.stem: 괄호 안의 단어를 알맞은 형태로 바꿔 쓰시오.

det.korean: frequent(형용사: 빈번한) → frequently(부사: 자주). 동사 built를 수식하는 부사가 필요합니다.
det.analysis:
__________ built 구조에서 동사(built) 앞에 부사 필요 → frequently
frequent(형) → frequently(부) / frequency(명)
det.tip: frequent(빈번한) → frequently(자주): -ly 접미사로 부사 변환. 원문에서도 'frequently built on family ties'로 사용

questions.passage: The early grain trade firms were active in both surplus-producing and food deficit regions, and these firms made it their business to know the state of supply and demand in both. Because this information was the key to their profitability, these firms worked in relative secrecy, frequently built on __________. In addition, these firms were able to benefit from the rise of commodity exchanges and commodities futures markets that emerged in the mid-1800s. Agricultural markets are naturally unstable, due to changes in harvest size that result from variable weather patterns and other factors. Locking-in prices by buying and selling grain for future delivery helped these firms to minimize such risks.
questions.stem: 빈칸에 들어갈 표현으로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: 비밀리에 운영된 이 회사들은 가족 유대, 신뢰, 충성심(family ties, trust, and loyalty)에 기반하여 활동했습니다.
det.analysis:
✅ ① family ties, trust, and loyalty: 원문 표현 그대로
❌ ② public relations(홍보): secrecy(비밀)와 모순
❌ ③ government regulations(정부 규제): 본문에 언급 없음
❌ ④ competition(경쟁): 비밀 운영과 맥락 불일치
det.tip: secrecy + family ties + trust + loyalty — 초기 곡물 무역의 폐쇄적 운영 방식을 보여주는 핵심 어구

questions.passage: The early grain trade firms were active in both surplus-producing and food deficit regions, and these firms made it their business to know the state of supply and demand in both. Because this information was the key to their profitability, these firms worked in relative secrecy. Agricultural markets are naturally unstable, due to changes in harvest size that result from variable weather patterns and other factors. Locking-in prices by buying and selling grain for future delivery helped these firms to minimize such risks. It made sense for the grain trading companies to __________.
questions.stem: 빈칸에 들어갈 표현으로 가장 적절한 것은?
ch: compete with each other across national borders
reduce their presence to a single domestic market
manage their risks within a single firm operating in more than one country
allow independent national companies to handle all overseas trade

det.korean: 곡물 무역 회사들이 여러 나라에서 운영되는 하나의 회사 내에서 위험을 관리하는 것이 합리적이었습니다.
det.analysis:
✅ ③ manage their risks within a single firm operating in more than one country: 원문 표현과 일치
❌ ① 서로 경쟁하는 것은 본문 취지와 반대 (단일 기업 내 통합 관리)
❌ ② 단일 국내 시장으로 축소는 multiple markets와 모순
❌ ④ 독립 국가 회사에 해외 무역을 맡기는 것은 rather than 뒤의 부정된 방식
det.tip: single firm in multiple countries vs. independent national companies — 이 대조가 본문의 핵심 논점
